name: input
description: Type text into a focusable input element on the active tab (text field, textarea, contenteditable). The index must come from the most recent observation's `elements[]`. Set `submit: true` to press Enter immediately after typing — useful for search boxes that submit on Enter. For filling multiple fields at once, prefer `BrowserFillForm`.

inputs.name: index
inputs.description: Required element index from the latest observation's elements[] list.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Required text to type. The framework focuses the element first; existing content is replaced if the field is selected on focus.

inputs.name: submit
inputs.description: If true, press Enter after typing. Useful for search boxes.
